summary: MountainAshBaseSettings extends pydantic-settings BaseSettings with multi-format config file loading (YAML, TOML, JSON, env), template-based field derivation, secrets resolution, and a post_init hook. It is the single most important class in the package — all user settings classes subclass it.
extension_points: post_init(): override in subclasses for template-driven derived fields
settings_customise_sources(): classmethod override to change source priority
lifecycle_notes: Calls SettingsParameters.create and merge before super().__init__
With validate_assignment=True, setattr triggers pydantic revalidation — use object.__setattr__ for bookkeeping-only fields
SETTINGS_SOURCE_* fields are harness bookkeeping, not user config — excluded from model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
documentation_hooks: Template syntax: {FIELD_NAME} in string fields, resolved at post_init
config_files accepts UPath, str, list, or tuple — dispatched to YAML/TOML/JSON/env by extension
secrets_provider wires secret: prefixes in kwargs and config-file-loaded fields
risks: validate_assignment=True means all setattr calls trigger full pydantic validation including SecretStr wrapping — can surprise callers who assign raw strings

model_config is mutated directly (yaml_file, toml_file, json_file) before super().__init__ — this is a class-level dict, so concurrent multi-threaded construction of different subclasses sharing the same model_config could race

evidence.detail: MountainAshBaseSettings exported from package root in __all__
Described as 'primary interface' in project docs
